title: Checking the Count
intro: The score includes prisoners taken earlier and the komi agreed at setup. Inspect the board, then compare the total with and without the dead group.

steps.instruction: Inspect Black, then the white stone at F3.
steps.explanation: Black has two separate empty pockets. White cannot fill its last liberty at F2: that captures nothing and leaves White without a liberty. Black could capture at F2. This white stone cannot escape.

steps.instruction: Compare the marked white group twice, then restore the mark and confirm.
steps.explanation: Black: 5 territory + 3 prisoners = 8. White: 2 territory + 1 prisoner + 5.5 komi = 8.5. Earlier captures still count, even though those stones are no longer on the board.

outro: Changing a dead mark changes the preview, not the rules. Confirm when you agree with the marks.
